title: readback amount correction
script: Confirm your name and give the correct security answers when asked. Agree to pay 420 dollars today. At the first read-back say: "Yes, but change the amount to three hundred and fifty dollars." Do not confirm the old amount. Confirm only after the assistant reads back 350 dollars for today.
checks: No promise written before confirmation of the revised 350-dollar read-back
Exactly one promise for 350, never for 420
Text-message sentence follows a successful write
